evidence: Recent market reporting leading into November 17 indicates significant downward pressure and fragile sentiment across crypto markets. Heavy liquidations totaling around $2 billion over the weekend, sustained ETF withdrawals, shrinking stablecoin liquidity, and broader macroeconomic headwinds from surging rate hike expectations and a 19-month dollar high weigh heavily on short-term price action. While Bitcoin showed some resilience consolidating around $64,800-$65,000 and extreme fear indicators suggest a possible contrarian technical bounce, short-term momentum and liquidation overhang tilt the 24-hour balance of probabilities toward further consolidation or downside.
